create_image.description: Render HTML (and optional CSS) into an image and get back a hosted image URL and an image id. Use the Get Image step with the id to download the image as a file.
create_image.name: create_image

parameters.description:
The HTML markup to render, for example "
Hello
".
parameters.name: html

parameters.description: Optional CSS styles applied to the HTML, for example ".card { padding: 24px; font-family: sans-serif; }".
parameters.name: css

parameters.description: Optional Google Fonts to load before rendering, by family name (for example 'Roboto').
parameters.name: google_fonts

parameters.description: Optional. Crop the image to the single element matching this CSS selector instead of the whole page.
parameters.name: selector

parameters.description: Optional. Wait this many milliseconds before capturing, to let animations or fonts settle.
parameters.name: ms_delay

parameters.description: Optional. Pixel density of the render, from 0.1 to 3. Use 2 or 3 for a sharper, higher-resolution image.
parameters.name: device_scale

parameters.description: Optional. Width of the render viewport, in pixels.
parameters.name: viewport_width

parameters.description: Optional. Height of the render viewport, in pixels.
parameters.name: viewport_height

id.description: The image id; pass it to the Get Image step to download the image

url.description: The hosted URL of the rendered image

get_image.description: Download an image created by a Create Image or Take Screenshot step and save it to your workspace's file storage. Returns a document reference and a download URL a later step can use.
get_image.name: get_image

parameters.description: The id of an image from a Create Image or Take Screenshot step.
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.description: Optional. Name to save the file under. The extension is adjusted to match the image's format when possible.
parameters.name: filename

content_type.description: MIME type of the saved image

document_ref.description: Reference to the saved image, for use by a later step

documents.description: The saved image, in the shape steps that send or upload files expect

content_type.description: MIME type of the saved file

document_ref.description: Reference to the saved file, for use by a later step

filename.description: Name the file was saved under

size_bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes

url.description: Download URL for the saved file

filename.description: Name the image was saved under

image_id.description: The id of the image that was downloaded

size_bytes.description: Size of the image in bytes

url.description: Download URL for the saved image

take_screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of a public web page and get back a hosted image URL and an image id. Use the Get Image step with the id to download the screenshot as a file.
take_screenshot.name: take_screenshot

parameters.description: The public web address (URL) to screenshot, e.g. https://example.com.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Capture the entire page height instead of just the visible area.
parameters.name: full_screen

parameters.description: Optional. Wait this many milliseconds after the page loads before capturing.
parameters.name: ms_delay

parameters.description: Optional. Width of the browser viewport, in pixels.
parameters.name: viewport_width

parameters.description: Optional. Height of the browser viewport, in pixels.
parameters.name: viewport_height

id.description: The image id; pass it to the Get Image step to download the screenshot

url.description: The hosted URL of the screenshot

description: Turn HTML and CSS into images and capture screenshots of public web pages with HTML/CSS to Image (HCTI).
